description: Codex 0.162's trust dialog on a new folder: numbered rows under a › highlight and Codex's compact "enter continue · esc back" footer. It looks like a menu, but Codex ignores the highlighted row's digit here ("1" only moves the highlight to row 1; seen live: a tap sent "1" and the card sat at "Sent, waiting for the agent"). Whatever style the model picks, classify() promotes a menu under that footer whose highlight it can ground to a cursor picker, answered with arrows and Enter; Codex's approval box ("Press enter to confirm or esc to cancel") keeps its digits. tests/test_cursor_select.py covers the promotion without a model. Layout from a real capture at 120 columns, path anonymised (tmux-rc, 2026-10-14).
